content.value_statement: Marketing page assembly can take time when component choices are unclear. This skill maps page goals to Tailark sections and implementation steps.
actual_capabilities: Selects Tailark sections for landing, pricing, about, and contact pages.
Recommends component order for common marketing page flows.
Maps page needs to specific Tailark component file names.
Guides customization of text, images, layout, icons, and theme usage.
Identifies when auth components should be handled by another skill.
limitations: Does not include the actual Tailark component source files.
Does not generate brand strategy, copy research, or visual assets by itself.
Assumes a Next.js project with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI conventions.
May need manual adjustments for accessibility, responsiveness, and content accuracy.

use_cases.title: Launch a SaaS Landing Page
use_cases.description: Choose hero, logo, feature, testimonial, and call-to-action sections for a focused product launch page.

use_cases.title: Build a Pricing Experience
use_cases.description: Select pricing cards or comparison tables with FAQ support for plans, trials, and upgrades.

use_cases.title: Assemble Company Pages
use_cases.description: Combine content, stats, team, contact, header, and footer sections into coherent company pages.

prompt_templates.title: Pick Sections
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a Tailark landing page for a small SaaS product. Recommend the sections and explain why each one fits.

prompt_templates.title: Create Page Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a section order for a pricing page with clear comparison, trust signals, FAQs, and a final call to action.

prompt_templates.title: Customize Components
prompt_templates.prompt: I am using Tailark components in a Next.js page. Recommend which components to copy, customize, and compose for a product analytics website.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Page Composition
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this planned Tailark page structure for clarity, conversion flow, missing sections, and components that should be replaced or reordered.

output_examples.input: Plan a landing page for an analytics product.
output_examples.output: A recommended flow with hero, logo cloud, dashboard-focused features, workflow accordion, testimonials, and final call to action.
A suggested composition using narrative content, bold stats, a team section, contact information, header, and footer.

output_examples.input: Choose components for a pricing page.
output_examples.output: A pricing section choice based on plan complexity, followed by FAQs and supporting trust elements.

best_practices: Start with the page goal before selecting components.
Replace placeholder images and copy with real brand assets.
Copy components locally when significant content or layout changes are needed.
anti_patterns: Importing every available Tailark component without a clear page flow.
Using auth components from this reference instead of the dedicated auth handler.
Leaving placeholder images, generic testimonials, or vague call-to-action text.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps plan and assemble marketing pages using Tailark components in a Next.js style project.

faq.question: Does it include component source code?
faq.answer: No. It references Tailark component names and file paths, but the source files must exist in the project.

faq.question: Can it build pricing pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends either a pricing section or comparison table, then pairs it with FAQs.

faq.question: Can it customize design details?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides changes to text, images, icons, layout, and theme-aware styling.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: What should I review before publishing?
faq.answer: Review accessibility, responsive behavior, asset quality, and factual accuracy of all marketing copy.
